messages:
Diane Park: Heads-up - NeonThera reached out, says they were charged a one-time setup fee twice on INV-2026-0789. Invoice total shows $9,450; expected $9,200 (setup fee $250). Can someone confirm?

Marco Silva: Looking. Invoice INV-2026-0789 lines: usage 9000, setup_fee 250, setup_fee 250 (duplicate). Looks like our onboarding job retried and created the second setup line.

Diane Park: Customer provided payment ref pay_zw9 and says the second charge hit their card yesterday. They want the duplicate refunded to the card and an internal note for their AP.

Marco Silva: For duplicated one-time items we typically refund the duplicate charge rather than credit note so their statement matches. Propose refund $250 to card ending 9876 and create memo CN-1902 for their AP showing refund reference. Need approval for refund.

Tania Roy: Approving refund $250 and memo. Use GL refund code 7001 and tag audit_id NEON_DUPSETUP_07. Also include remediation note: onboarding idempotency fix. :+1:

Marco Silva: Running refund:
```
/stripe-refund --txn pay_zw9_dup --amount 250 --reason "duplicate_setup_fee" --metadata invoice=INV-2026-0789 customer=neonthera
```

billing-bot: Refund initiated REF-5782 amount $250 status=processing. Ledger entry created, GL 7001, note: "refund duplicate setup fee; ticket ENG-1970 created".

Marco Silva: Creating memo PDF for AP and a short one-line explanation for the customer: "We refunded $250 (duplicate setup fee) to your original payment; please see REF-5782 for bank reference."

CS-bot: Logged customer message - NeonThera asked whether this will affect their next month's billing. Diane, can you confirm reply?

Diane Park: Replied: "This was a duplicate one-time charge only; your monthly usage invoices are unaffected." Customer said "thanks" and requested the refund memo emailed to ap@neonthera.com.

billing-bot: Refund REF-5782 moved to refunded. Memo CN-1902 generated and emailed to ap@neonthera.com. Audit tag NEON_DUPSETUP_07 attached to ledger.

Marco Silva: Closing thread. ENG ticket ENG-1970 assigned to eng-onboard to add idempotency key and dedupe check for setup items. Leave notes in billing adjustments for July.

Tania Roy: Thanks team. Please add a short root cause line in the memo for auditors: "onboarding job retry caused duplicate one-time charge".

Diane Park: Added that line and archived the case. :white_check_mark:
thread_summary: NeonThera was billed a duplicate one-time setup fee on INV-2026-0789; finance refunded $250 (REF-5782), generated memo CN-1902 for AP, and opened ENG-1970 to remediate onboarding idempotency.
